output: Time complexity describes how runtime grows with input size n. Common classes are O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), and O(n^2). Example: scanning a vector is O(n). A good analysis states both time and auxiliary space complexity.

Space complexity describes memory growth. A loop that sums a vector using one integer accumulator takes O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Creating a second vector of n elements adds O(n) auxiliary space.

The Standard Template Library provides containers, algorithms, iterators, and utilities. Examples include std::vector, std::map, std::unordered_map, std::sort, and std::find. Using these tested standard-library tools is usually better than reinventing common structures.

push_back adds an existing value or object. emplace_back constructs an object in place from constructor arguments. emplace_back can avoid a temporary, but is not always faster; choose whichever makes the code clearer.
reserve(n) requests capacity without changing vector size. resize(n) changes the number of elements. After reserve on an empty vector, indexing v[0] is still invalid because size remains zero.

An operation can invalidate an iterator, pointer, or reference. For std::vector, reallocation during growth invalidates all iterators and references to elements. Do not keep using an iterator after an operation that may invalidate it.
std::stack is LIFO: last in, first out. std::queue is FIFO: first in, first out. Check empty() before calling top(), front(), or pop() on an adaptor.

std::priority_queue is a heap adaptor. By default it is a max-heap, so top() returns the largest element. A min-heap can be declared as std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, std::greater<int>>. top is O(1), push and pop are O(log n).
std::set stores unique keys in sorted order with O(log n) operations. std::unordered_set has no sorted order and average O(1) lookup, insertion, and removal. Use set when ordering matters.

std::lower_bound returns the first iterator whose element is not less than the target in a sorted range. If it equals end(), no element is at least the target. On a sorted vector it performs O(log n) comparisons.

std::upper_bound returns the first element strictly greater than the target in a sorted range. lower_bound and upper_bound together can locate all occurrences of a value; std::equal_range returns both boundaries.

std::stable_sort preserves the relative order of elements that compare equivalent. std::sort is generally O(n log n) but does not guarantee stability. Use stable_sort when the original order of equal-key elements matters.

A lambda capture determines which local variables the lambda can access. [x] captures x by value; [&x] captures by reference. Ensure referenced variables outlive the lambda, and avoid broad reference captures if the lambda may escape the current scope.

std::function is a type-erased wrapper for compatible callables such as functions and lambdas. It is useful for callbacks but may have overhead. Check that it is not empty before calling a default-constructed std::function.

noexcept declares that a function is not expected to let exceptions escape. If an exception escapes a noexcept function, std::terminate is called. Only mark a function noexcept when that promise is correct.

A class with at least one pure virtual function is abstract and cannot be instantiated directly. Derived classes must implement inherited pure virtual functions to become concrete. Abstract classes are useful for defining interfaces.

std::string_view is a lightweight, non-owning view of characters. It avoids copying but does not extend the lifetime of the underlying data. A view must not outlive its backing string: using it after the string is destroyed or invalidated is undefined behavior.

std::variant<Ts...> safely stores one value from a fixed set of types. Use std::get when the active type is known or std::visit to handle alternatives. std::get with the wrong type throws std::bad_variant_access.

A mutex protects shared mutable state between threads. Use std::lock_guard or std::scoped_lock so the mutex is released automatically. Unsynchronized conflicting accesses can cause a data race, which is undefined behavior.

A data race occurs when threads access the same memory concurrently, at least one access writes, and no proper synchronization exists. In C++ this is undefined behavior. Use atomics for suitable simple values or mutexes for shared state.

A deadlock occurs when threads wait indefinitely for resources held by one another. Acquire locks in a consistent order, keep critical sections short, and consider std::scoped_lock for locking multiple mutexes together.

Dynamic programming reuses solutions to overlapping subproblems. Define the state, transition, base cases, and evaluation order. Memoization is top-down caching; tabulation is bottom-up. Analyze both time and space complexity.

Backtracking explores candidate solutions step by step. Choose an option, recurse, then undo the choice before trying another. It is used for permutations, combinations, Sudoku, and N-Queens; worst-case time is often exponential.

Sliding window maintains a contiguous range while moving its boundaries. It can reduce many O(nk) brute-force solutions to O(n). Make sure the problem's condition supports safely expanding and shrinking the window; negative values can invalidate some sum-based tricks.

Two pointers move through a sequence to avoid repeated work. For a sorted array and target sum, move the left pointer right when the sum is too small and the right pointer left when too large. This is O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

A prefix sum stores cumulative totals. With prefix[i+1] = prefix[i] + nums[i], the inclusive range sum from l to r is prefix[r+1] - prefix[l]. Building takes O(n), each query O(1), and the prefix array uses O(n) space.
XOR has properties x ^ x == 0 and x ^ 0 == x. If every value in a sequence appears exactly twice except one value, XORing all values returns the unique one in O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

Integer overflow happens when a result does not fit in its type. Signed integer overflow is undefined behavior in C++. Use an appropriate wider type and promote before arithmetic, for example 1LL * a * b. Casting after overflow does not fix it.
Use long long for sums, products, or counts that may exceed int range. For multiplication, 1LL * a * b promotes the operation before multiplying. long long can still overflow, so check constraints.

const correctness communicates which values a function will not modify. Pass large read-only objects as const T& to avoid copying. Mark member functions const when they do not modify the observable object state.

static has several meanings: a local static persists between calls; a static class member belongs to the class rather than one object; at namespace scope, static can give internal linkage. Interpret it based on where it appears.

instruction: what is a declaration vs definition?
output: A declaration introduces a name and its type. A definition provides the entity itself, such as a function body. A function can be declared in a header and defined in one source file. Avoid multiple conflicting definitions across translation units.

inline does not force machine-code inlining. It permits identical definitions in multiple translation units under the One Definition Rule, making it useful for functions defined in headers. The compiler still decides whether to inline calls.
if constexpr (C++17) selects a branch at compile time. The discarded branch is not instantiated for that template specialization. It is useful for type-dependent template logic.

A concept names compile-time requirements for template arguments and can improve diagnostics. For example, template<std::integral T> restricts T to integral types. Concepts do not replace runtime validation of input values.

why is vector index out of bounds?
output: For a vector of size n, valid indexes are 0 through n-1. reserve() changes capacity, not size. During debugging, v.at(i) throws std::out_of_range for invalid indexes, unlike operator[].

instruction: why do I get a linker error?
output: A linker error often means a function was declared but not defined, the source file containing the definition was not linked, signatures differ, or multiple definitions exist. Read the unresolved or duplicate symbol in the first meaningful linker message.

Reproduce the bug with a small input. Compile with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -g. Read the first meaningful error, inspect variables with a debugger, and use sanitizers such as -fsanitize=address,undefined where available. Test empty, boundary, duplicate, and extreme inputs.

instruction: how should I explain an interview solution?
output: Restate the problem and constraints, describe a baseline, improve it, explain why it works, dry-run an example, and state time and auxiliary space complexity. Then code cleanly and test edge cases such as empty input, one element, duplicates, and extremes.
